formats.label: SubRip (.srt) captions: at most 2 lines of 42 characters per cue, no overlaps, for players and editors.
WebVTT (.vtt) captions for the HTML <track> element, with speaker voice tags when known.
Advanced SubStation Alpha (.ass) subtitles with a readable default style, for mpv, VLC, ffmpeg burn-in and Aegisub. Bilingual subtitles show the second language in a smaller style.
TTML / IMSC (.ttml) timed text XML for broadcast, streaming packagers and players that read TTML or DFXP.
YouTube SubViewer (.sbv) captions, the format YouTube Studio imports and exports.
LRC (.lrc) timed lyrics, one [mm:ss.xx] line per cue, for music players and karaoke apps.
CSV (.csv) with one row per segment: start,end,speaker,text in seconds, plus secondary_text for bilingual output. For spreadsheets and data tools.
Plain text (.txt), with [m:ss] lines when timestamps is on
JSON segments (.json): start, end, text, speaker, with language and origin
Original file as the site (or the local sidecar) has it
